target_operation.operation: Construct a real Reporter with TAP output and minimal app config, report a failure under bail threshold1, then finish and inspect its output.
target_operation.required_effect: Emit Bail out! with reason and bail summary without a caller-installed app.reporter self-reference.
target_operation.delivered_patch_effect: Independent Verifier TAP/Reporter bail-output cases receive ordinary fail summary without required Bail out! and bail metadata.
target_operation.focal_failure_selection: Select TAP output / Reporter bail behavior from multiple independent failures. Do not generalize this one assembly to all adapter/runner errors.
